scripts.ensure:cli-dist: pnpm -C ../../packages/api-adapter build && pnpm -C ../../packages/protocol build && pnpm -C ../../packages/buyer-core build && pnpm -C ../../packages/node build && pnpm -C ../../packages/provider-core build && pnpm -C ../../packages/router-core build && pnpm -C ../../packages/ant-agent build && pnpm -C ../../plugins/router-local build && pnpm -C ../../packages/antseed-verifier build && pnpm -C ../payments build:server && pnpm -C ../ants build && pnpm -C ../cli build
scripts.prebuild: npm run ensure:cli-dist && npm run brand:electron-dev && npm run ensure:native && node ../../scripts/remove-paths.mjs dist
scripts.predev: npm run ensure:cli-dist && npm run brand:electron-dev && npm run ensure:native && node ../../scripts/remove-paths.mjs dist/main
scripts.prestart: npm run ensure:cli-dist && npm run brand:electron-dev && npm run ensure:native
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm run build:main && node --test $(find dist/main -name '*.test.js') && pnpm run test:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prepare-dist && node scripts/dist.mjs
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run prepare-dist && electron-builder --win
scripts.release:win: npm run build && npm run prepare-dist && node scripts/release-win.mjs
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.linux.cjs --linux
scripts.release:linux: npm run build && npm run prepare-dist && electron-builder --config electron-builder.linux.cjs --linux --publish always
